subject: Recording file corrected
text:
The issue noted last week is valid. The recording file for Tuesday’s lecture was incomplete because my upload stalled on my phone after the internet dropped. I noticed after sending it and did not fix it immediately, which I should have done.

I have replaced the file with the corrected version and checked the duration against the class schedule. The timestamp near forty-three minutes was also corrected. If you like, I can send the source video as a backup or a summary of the missing section.

For future sessions, I will upload from a computer, verify playback, and confirm when the file is live.
